lookup.app: SELECT id FROM applications WHERE name LIKE 'SMOKE % Scoped Reservations' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
lookup.ap: SELECT l.id FROM locations l JOIN application_scopes s ON s.location_id = l.id WHERE l.name LIKE 'SMOKE % Airport' AND s.removed_at IS NULL ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1

lookup.sap: SELECT id FROM application_scopes WHERE application_id = {{app}} AND location_id = {{ap}} AND removed_at IS NULL
lookup.pgrant: SELECT id FROM application_access WHERE application_id = {{app}} AND member_id = 26 AND revoked_at IS NULL

lookup.revoked: SELECT 'yes' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM application_access WHERE scope_id = {{sap}} AND revoked_at IS NULL)
lookup.logged: SELECT 'yes' FROM activity_log WHERE action = 'application_scope.remove' AND entity_id = {{app}} AND (after->>'grants_revoked')::int = 1
